title: No Milk in the Fridge  (No hay leche en la nevera)

segments.t: De vuelta en la cocina del café, Tessa abre la nevera y suelta un suspiro justo cuando entran Hannah y el dueño, Arthur. Ocho huéspedes se están despertando arriba y el desayuno empieza en veinte minutos. Escucha primero.
Oh no! Arthur, Hannah, we have a kitchen emergency!
Please do not say the word emergency before my morning coffee!
The dairy van has a flat tire outside town. Look in the fridge!
One tiny splash of milk, two eggs, and no butter at all!
Eight hungry guests will come down the stairs at seven thirty!
My bread is already in the oven, at least.
Give me a bag and some cash! The corner market opens at seven.
Can you run there and back in ten minutes?
Watch me! Tell me exactly what to buy.
Three bottles of milk, twenty eggs, butter, cheese, and red apples!
Here is fifty from the cash box. Bring back the receipt!
Hold the fort, I am already out the door!
Desgranemos ahora la escena línea por línea.
Oh no! Arthur, Hannah, we have a kitchen emergency!
'¡Oh, no! Arthur, Hannah, ¡tenemos una emergencia en la cocina!'
Please do not say the word emergency before my morning coffee!
'¡Por favor, no digas la palabra emergencia antes de mi café de la mañana!'
The dairy van has a flat tire outside town. Look in the fridge!
'La furgoneta de los lácteos tiene una rueda pinchada a las afueras. ¡Miren en la nevera!'
One tiny splash of milk, two eggs, and no butter at all!
'¡Un chorrito diminuto de leche, dos huevos y nada de mantequilla!'
Eight hungry guests will come down the stairs at seven thirty!
'¡Ocho huéspedes hambrientos bajarán las escaleras a las siete y media!'
My bread is already in the oven, at least.
'Mi pan ya está en el horno, al menos.'
Give me a bag and some cash! The corner market opens at seven.
'¡Dame una bolsa y algo de efectivo! El mercado de la esquina abre a las siete.'
Can you run there and back in ten minutes?
'¿Puedes ir corriendo y volver en diez minutos?'
Watch me! Tell me exactly what to buy.
'¡Mírame hacerlo! Dime exactamente qué comprar.'
Three bottles of milk, twenty eggs, butter, cheese, and red apples!
'¡Tres botellas de leche, veinte huevos, mantequilla, queso y manzanas rojas!'
Here is fifty from the cash box. Bring back the receipt!
'Aquí tienes cincuenta de la caja. ¡Trae de vuelta el recibo!'
Hold the fort, I am already out the door!
'¡Cuiden el fuerte, que ya estoy saliendo por la puerta!'
Escuchemos otra vez toda la escena a velocidad normal.
Oh no! Arthur, Hannah, we have a kitchen emergency!
Please do not say the word emergency before my morning coffee!
The dairy van has a flat tire outside town. Look in the fridge!
One tiny splash of milk, two eggs, and no butter at all!
Eight hungry guests will come down the stairs at seven thirty!
My bread is already in the oven, at least.
Give me a bag and some cash! The corner market opens at seven.
Can you run there and back in ten minutes?
Watch me! Tell me exactly what to buy.
Three bottles of milk, twenty eggs, butter, cheese, and red apples!
Here is fifty from the cash box. Bring back the receipt!
Hold the fort, I am already out the door!
Con una lista de compras y efectivo de la caja, Hannah sale disparada hacia el mercado de la esquina. La próxima vez veremos con qué regresa.
See you later!
